recipes.title: Sticky one-pan Mongolian beef with noodles recipe
recipes.description: My one-pan Mongolian beef with noodles recipe is set to become a Friday night fake-away favourite as it is for my family.
ingredients: 1/2 x 340g pkt dried thin egg noodles
Coles Asia Fried Shallots, to serve
instructions: Place noodles in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 5 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, combine hoisin, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and ginger in a jug.
Toss beef and cornflour in a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large, deep frying pan over medium-high heat. In 2 batches, cook beef for 2 minutes on each side or until browned and crisp.

Heat remaining oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Add red onion, shallot and garlic, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until starting to char. Add noodles, beef and hoisin mixture. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until heated through.
Serve beef mixture sprinkled with sesame seeds and fried shallots. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our Mongolian one-pan beef with noodles recipe.

recipes.title: Easy cinnamon roll cheesecake cookies recipe
recipes.description: The flavours of cinnamon rolls and cheesecake combine in these cinnamon roll cheesecake cookies (using a simple shortcut supermarket find!).
ingredients: 250g cream cheese, chopped, at room temperature
instructions: Use electric beaters to beat cream cheese, cream and sugar in a bowl until firm peaks form. Spoon mixture into a piping bag fitted with a 1cm plain nozzle.

Arrange cookies on a serving plate. Starting from the centre of 1 cookie, pipe a continuous ring of cream cheese mixture on the top of the cookie to cover. Repeat with remaining cookies. Dust with cinnamon sugar, to serve.

recipes.title: Easy one-pot cheesy Italian rissoles recipe
recipes.description: These easy one-pot cheesy Italian rissoles are simmered in a rich tomato sauce and make light work of dinner.
ingredients: Finely grated parmesan, extra, to serve
instructions: Place mince, breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic and egg in a bowl. Season. Use dampened hands to mix until well combined. Divide into 8 equal portions and shape into patties. Press a cube of mozzarella into the centre of each patty and reshape to enclose and form a rissole shape. Place on a tray and transfer to the fridge for 30 minutes to chill.
Heat half of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. In batches, cook the rissoles, for 6-8 minutes, turning halfway, or until golden and almost cooked through. Transfer to a plate.

Heat remaining oil in the same pan over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring, for 4-5 minutes or until softened. Add pasta sauce and water. Bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low. Add rissoles and cook, turning rissoles occasionally, for 10 minutes or until rissoles are cooked through and the sauce is thickened slightly. Add spinach, cover and simmer for 1 minute or until spinach is wilted. Remove pan from the heat. Season. Sprinkle with extra parmesan and basil. Serve with crusty bread alongside. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our one-pot cheesy Italian rissoles recipe.

recipes.title: Mexican-style pork al pastor rice tacos recipe
recipes.description: These Mexican-style pork al pastor rice tacos are easy to make at home and are full of flavour.
ingredients: 3 x 250g pkt Flavourful Mexican Style Microwave Rice
Coles Creamy Salsa Verde sauce, to drizzle
instructions: Use a sharp knife to remove pork rind from the leg roast. Slice the pork pieces crossways into 1.5cm-thick pieces, then cut each piece in half. Place the pork in a bowl. Add pineapple salsa and seasoning mix. Toss until the pork is well coated. Place in the fridge for 4 hours or overnight to marinate.

Use a sharp knife to remove pineapple skin. Cut off the base and top of the pineapple and discard. Stand the pineapple up on 1 cut end. Cut down the length of the pineapple, close to the skin, being careful not to remove too much flesh. Hold pineapple in one hand. Cut 1cm-deep wedges around the flesh, following the diagonal line of ‘eyes’. Cut two 2.5cm-thick slices from the pineapple. Cut three 1cm-thick slices from the remaining pineapple.

Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan forced. Line the base of a vertical skewer pan with baking paper. Push 1 thick slice of pineapple onto the skewer. Push a third of the pork onto the skewer, then 1 thin pineapple slice. Repeat with the remaining pork and thin pineapple slices. Top with the remaining thicker pineapple slice. Roast for 1 hour 30 minutes or until slightly charred and cooked through.
Meanwhile, microwave rice following packet directions. Warm tortillas following packet directions.

Use a large, sharp knife to slice down the pork skewer. Divide the rice among the tortillas. Top with the avocado, pork mixture and red onion. Drizzle with [salsa verde=9, label""] and sprinkle with coriander. Serve with lime wedges. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our Mexican-style pork al pastor rice tacos recipe.

recipes.title: Easy cheesy chicken taco pockets recipe
recipes.description: Fun, family-friendly and really easy to pull together, you’ll love our cheesy chicken taco pockets
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, deseeded, thinly sliced
1 whole barbecued chicken, meat shredded, skin and bones discarded
250g Simply Cheddar Cheese block, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan forced. Grease and line 2 baking trays.

Heat oil in a large, non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add onion and capsicum. Cook, stirring, for 4-5 minutes or until softened. Add seasoning mix and cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until aromatic. Add tomato paste and water, and stir to combine. Add chicken and stir until combined and warmed through. Remove from the heat.

Place 1 halved wrap on a clean work surface. Place 1 heaped tbsp cheese in the centre. Top with one-twelfth of the chicken mixture. Fold the wrap in half to form a triangle and enclose the filling. Repeat with remaining wraps, cheese and chicken mixture to make 12 triangles. Arrange triangles, seam-side down, across the prepared trays in a circular pattern (a bit like a cut pizza).

Spread tops with sour cream, then sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 12-14 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden. Top with sour cream, tomato, avocado and coriander. Season with pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Quick Kung Pao beef noodles (ready in 20 minutes!)
recipes.description: My quick Kung Pao beef noodles recipe is as tasty as a Chinese takeaway and ready faster than your delivery apps!
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, cut into thin wedges
2 tsp Sichuan chilli crisp or sambal oelek (optional)
1/2 x 400g pkt hand-pulled noodles or dried rice stick noodles
Extra Sichuan chilli crisp, to drizzle (optional)
instructions: Combine soy, hoisin and vinegar in a small jug.

Heat oil in a large frying pan or wok over high heat. Add beef and cook, breaking up mince with a wooden spoon, for 5 minutes or until browned. Add garlic and cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until aromatic. Add capsicum, dried chillies and peas, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until vegetables are almost tender. Add soy mixture, chilli crisp and two-thirds of shallot, and cook, stirring, until heated through.
Meanwhile, cook [noodles=12, label= ""] according to packet instructions. Drain.
Add noodles to the beef mixture and toss to combine. Sprinkle beef with remaining shallot and drizzle with extra chilli crisp, if using. Serve.

recipes.title: Cheat’s chicken katsudon recipe
recipes.description: Using a clever shortcut ingredient, you can make my easy cheat’s chicken katsudon recipe any night of the week.
ingredients: 400g Simply RSPCA Approved Chicken Burger Crumbed
1 brown onion, halved, cut into thin wedges
4 green shallots, shredded or thinly sliced diagonally
100g snow peas, steamed, thinly sliced lengthways
instructions: Rinse rice in a sieve under cold running water to remove excess starch. Drain well, then place in a medium saucepan. Add water and bring to the boil over medium-high heat. Cover, reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 12 minutes or until water is absorbed. Set aside, covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper and arrange burger patties on the tray. Bake, turning over halfway, for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Alternatively, preheat an air fryer to 200°C and cook, turning over halfway, for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown.

While the burger patties are cooking, combine onion, stock, soy sauce and mirin in a large frying pan. Bring to the boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to medium. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until the onion has softened.
Slice the cooked chicken burgers into 4 pieces, keeping the shape intact. Pick sliced burgers up using an egg flip and slide into the pan. Drizzle the egg over and around each sliced burger.

Cover and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the egg has just set. Divide rice among serving bowls. Top with sliced chicken burgers and stock mixture, nori and green shallot. Serve with snow peas alongside.

recipes.title: Easy air fryer ‘marry me’ chicken recipe
recipes.description: I’ve transformed the viral favourite ‘marry me’ chicken recipe for those who love using their air fryer to cook dinner.
ingredients: 20g sun-dried tomato halves, fat free (no oil), finely chopped
instructions: Place chicken in a bowl. Add ¼ cup sun-dried tomato pesto and toss until well coated.
Preheat the air fryer at 180°C for 3 minutes. Place the chicken in an ovenproof pan or dish. Place in the air fryer basket and cook at 180°C for 10 minutes or until golden.
Meanwhile, combine cream, garlic, sun-dried tomato, basil, chilli and remaining sun-dried tomato pesto in a jug. Season.

Pour the cream mixture around the chicken and sprinkle with parmesan. Air fry at 180°C for 5 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Divide pasta and chicken among serving bowls. Stir the sauce in the pan and drizzle over the top of the chicken. Serve with spinach alongside.

recipes.title: Rice cooker Mexican chicken and rice recipe
recipes.description: Allow your rice cooker to create this easy and super-flavourful Mexican chicken and rice recipe.
ingredients: 500g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 2cm pieces
instructions: Place chicken in a bowl with garlic powder, paprika, oregano and oil. Season and stir to coat.

Combine stock and tomato paste in a jug. Season. Place rice, beans and corn in a rice cooker. Pour over stock mixture and stir to combine. Top with chicken mixture. Cover with the lid and place on the ‘Cook’ setting for 20 minutes. Stand mixture on the ‘Warm’ setting, without opening, for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine tomato and coriander in a small bowl. Season.
Fluff up the rice mixture. Serve rice mixture topped with tomato salsa and feta, and with lime wedges alongside.

recipes.title: ‘Marry me’ chicken potato bake recipe
recipes.description: My ‘marry me’ chicken potato bake recipe uses leftover barbecue chicken to create a delicious family dinner.
ingredients: 70g sun-dried tomato halves, fat free (no oil), thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°C/150°C fan forced. Use a mandoline to thinly slice potato and onion. Combine cream and sun-dried tomato pesto in a jug. Season.

Arrange one-third of the potato slices over the base of a 3L (12 cup) ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with half of the onion, chicken, sun-dried tomato halves and spinach. Pour over a third of the cream mixture. Repeat layers, then finish with a layer of potato and remaining cream mixture.

Cover dish with baking paper then foil and place on a baking tray. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until the potato is tender. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and the potato is very tender. Serve.

recipes.title: Slow cooker Thai green chicken curry recipe
recipes.description: This flavourful slow cooker Thai green chicken curry is easy to make at home.
ingredients: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 3cm pieces
250.00 ml coriander roots, stems and leaves
instructions: To make the green curry paste, place chillies, garlic, ginger, lime leaves, lemongrass, coriander, sugar, shallot, cumin, ground coriander and water in a small food processor or blender and process until a smooth paste forms. This will take a few minutes and makes 1 1/4 cups curry paste.

Place curry paste, coconut milk, stock, chicken and fish sauce in a 3.5L slow cooker and stir to combine. Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours. Stir in beans and broccolini, and cook for 10-15 minutes or until tender.
Serve curry on steamed rice, scattered with extra coriander.

recipes.title: Crispy feta-crusted chicken gyros recipe
recipes.description: This gyros has feta spread on the outside of the pita bread to create crispy feta chicken gyros magic.
ingredients: 500g (about 4 large) boneless, skinless chicken thigh fillets
Fresh lemon juice, extra, to serve
instructions: Combine garlic, lemon rind, 2 tbsp of the lemon juice, oregano and [two thirds of oil=4, label= "2 tbsp of oil"] in a bowl. Season. Add chicken and toss well to coat. Set aside for 20 minutes (or place in the fridge for up to 4 hours) to marinate.

Heat a large, non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 minutes on each side or until deeply golden, lightly charred and cooked through. Transfer to a bowl and rest for 5 minutes, lightly covered with foil. Thickly slice.

Wipe out the pan with paper towel and return to medium heat. Crumble and sprinkle one-quarter of the feta onto 1 of the pita bread. Use the back of a spoon to spread slightly and squash onto the bread to adhere. Repeat with the remaining feta and breads.

Heat [one quarter of remaining oil=4, label= "2 tsp of oil] in the frying pan over medium heat. Add the pita, cheese-side down and cook for 2 minutes or until the feta is caramelised and crisp. You can take a peak using a flat spatula. Flip and cook for 30 seconds to warm through. Repeat with the remaining oil and pita. Spread the inside of each feta-crusted pita with tzatziki. Top with tomato, sliced chicken, red onion and parsley. Sprinkle over with remaining lemon juice and some extra lemon juice. Fold over or roll up and wrap, to serve.

recipes.title: Tomatokeftedes (Greek tomato fritters) recipe
recipes.description: This tomatokeftedes (Greek tomato fritters) recipe is a simple, herby meal I’ve made based on my memories of travelling to Santorini, Greece.
ingredients: 125.00 ml fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
125.00 ml fresh continental parsley leaves, finely chopped
40.00 ml fresh oregano leaves, finely chopped
Lemon wedges, to squeeze over and serve
Extra fresh continental parsley leaves, coarsely chopped, to serve
instructions: Sift flour and bicarb into a small bowl.
Place grape tomato, Roma tomato, shallot, onion, feta, mint, parsley and oregano in a large bowl. Season with salt. Tip in flour mixture and stir until well combined.

Pour enough oil into a large, non-stick frying pan to come 1cm up the side. Heat over medium-high heat until hot. In 4 batches, spoon 4 large tablespoonfuls of batter into the pan to form each fritter, flattening slightly with the back of a fork. Cook for 2 minutes each side or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel to drain.
Divide fritters among serving plates. Squeeze a few lemon wedges over the fritters and sprinkle with extra parsley. Serve with tzatziki and more lemon wedges alongside.

recipes.title: Spanakorizo recipe (Greek spinach and rice)
recipes.description: With only a few simple ingredients, this Greek spinach and rice spanakorizo recipe packs so much flavour. It’s an ideal vegetarian dinner recipe idea and works well as a side dish, too.
ingredients: 2 small bunches English spinach, rinsed, roughly chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 minutes or until just softened. Add spinach, and cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes or until starting to wilt.

Add rice and stir to coat. Add passata, water and lemon juice. Season, then bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes or until almost all of the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Serve with lemon cheeks for squeezing over.

recipes.title: Buttery broccoli spanakopita recipe
recipes.description: Warren Mendes’s buttery broccoli spanakopita is loaded with green vegetables and feel-good ingredients.
ingredients: 62.50 ml chopped fresh continental parsley leaves
40.00 ml chopped fresh dill, finely chopped
Extra fresh continental parsley leaves, to garnish
instructions: Cut florets from broccoli and place in a heatproof bowl. Finely chop the broccoli stem and add to the bowl. Cover with boiling water and set aside for 3-4 minutes until slightly softened and bright green. Drain into a fine sieve. Add thawed spinach to the sieve and use the back of a spatula to press out excess liquid. Transfer to a bowl.
Add parsley, shallot, dill, lemon rind and juice, nutmeg, garlic and egg. Season well and stir to combine. Add feta and oil. Stir to combine but don’t break up the feta too much. Set aside.

Preheat oven to 200°C/180°C fan forced. Place filo on a clean work surface. Cover with a dry tea towel then a damp tea towel (to prevent filo drying out). Brush 1 sheet with a little butter. Lay half of the sheet in the bottom of a 26cm cast-iron frying pan or round baking dish with the remaining half of the sheet hanging over the side. Repeat with the remaining filo and butter, working around the pan clockwise so that the base is evenly covered and contains 12 layers of filo. Add the broccoli mixture and press down evenly. Carefully bring the overhanging pastry back over the top of the filling to cover, adjusting the sheets to cover any gaps. Brush with the remaining butter. Sprinkle with black and white sesame seeds. Bake for 40 minutes until golden and crisp. Garnish with extra parsley and serve with yoghurt and lemon wedges alongside.

recipes.title: Spinach and lentil gozleme-inspired pasta bake recipe
recipes.description: This vegetarian spinach and lentil gozleme-inspired pasta bake is so easy to put together and is budget-friendly, too!
ingredients: 400g butternut pumpkin, peeled, cut into 3mm-thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan-forced. Grease a 6cm-deep, 18cm x 26cm baking dish.
Cook pasta in a saucepan of salted, boiling water following packet instructions or until al dente. Drain. Return pasta to the pan and stir in garlic sauce and tomato paste. Season.
Place pasta mixture in base of the prepared dish, pressing down to compact. Top with pumpkin slices, covering as much of the pasta as possible. Season. Scatter evenly with lentils.
Combine spinach and ricotta in a bowl. Season, then even scatter over the lentil layer and press down to compact. Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes or until pumpkin is just tender.
Preheat an oven grill on high. Uncover pasta bake. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese and grill for 2 minutes or until the cheese is golden and bubbling. Stand for 10 minutes, before serving.

recipes.title: 20-minute easy tofu san choy bau
recipes.description: Whether you're a seasoned tofu fan or dipping your toe into meat-free cooking, this easy tofu vegetarian dinner can be on the table in 20 minutes!
ingredients: 500g pkt Nature’s Kitchen Plant Based Firm Tofu, drained, pat dried with paper towel, crumbled
65g (1/3 cup) sliced water chestnuts, finely chopped
Thinly sliced green shallot, to serve
Sliced fresh bird’s-eye chilli, to serve (optional)
Finely chopped unsalted roasted peanuts, to serve
Coles Asia Cantonese Style Hoisin Sauce, extra, to serve
Steamed long-grain white rice, to serve
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add vegetables and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until just starting to soften. Add garlic and ginger, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until aromatic. Add tofu and water chestnuts, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until heated through. Add hoisin and sesame oil. Stir-fry, tossing to coat the mixture in the sauce, for 1 minute or until mixture is combined and heated through.
Serve mixture in lettuce cups topped with shallot, chilli, if using, peanuts and extra hoisin sauce, and with rice alongside.

recipes.title: Mary Kalifatidis' Greek spinach pie recipe
recipes.description:
This recipe is inspired by my mum’s homemade spanakopita, where she creates her own pastry. It’s rich in flavour, with a perfectly crisp and flaky filo crust encasing a deliciously cheesy spinach filling.
As impressive as part of a dinner party table as it is for a midweek meal, my spinach pie is a feel-good, vegetarian comfort meal brimming with flavour.

What I love about this spinach pie recipe
This is a pie that has it all. My spinach pie is equal parts comforting and delicious. It’s filled with the goodness of green vegies, two types of cheese and 3 eggs, and looks showstopping when served, too. It’s also so full of delicious flavours, owing to fresh dill, leek, tangy feta and green shallots. Of course, you can serve it with a side salad, if you like. And, better yet, using store-bought filo pastry makes it an easy-to-assemble pie. 
This recipe also works well in a 35 x 20cm baking tray if you don’t have a 30cm round pan. 
For best results, let the pie develop a deep golden-brown colour. This ensures a crispy, well-cooked base.

💡Tip: avoid a soggy pie
Squeeze as much water as possible out of the spinach after cooking. If your spinach is too watery, your pie will lose its crispy flaky layers. See extra recipe notes below the recipe. 
Key ingredients in this spinach pie



English spinach: lush green spinach leaves are the key filling, and it’s a great idea to give them a good rinse before using them. A good way to check all the sand and dirt is removed from the spinach is to rub your fingers down the base of the leaf and feel for any sand remaining. You don’t want any grittiness in your pie!


Leek: thinly sliced leek adds extra savoury, onion-like flavour to the pie filling. 


Green shallots (spring onions): finely chopped green shallots form a lovely sharp contrast to the cheeses in this pie and bring extra depth to the mixture.


Dill: just like you’d find in a spanakopita, this spinach pie gets a fresh flavour boost from dill.


Ricotta: fresh ricotta contributes its rich creaminess to the pie.


Feta: this salted cheese imparts its quintessential tangy flavour and is a great match for the greens in this pie filling. Before adding the feta to this recipe, it’s best to wash the brine off it.


Butter and olive oil: these are combined in this recipe and serve multiple roles in this pie.


Eggs: lightly whisked eggs up the protein factor in the spinach filling.


Filo pastry: filo pastry is the case for my spinach pie and creates a beautifully textured and crinkly top for it.


White and black sesame seeds: while sesame seeds finish the pie, if you don’t have them, you can easily do without.



See my helpful tips below the recipe to find out how to make the best possible version of this simple pie.
If you love this recipe, try these 12 recipes that showcase the delicious combination of feta and spinach. 
Recipe, images and notes by food writer and recipe developer Mary Kalifatidis
ingredients: White and black sesame seeds, to sprinkle (optional)
instructions: Trim the stems of the spinach. Wash thoroughly 4-5 times until all the sand and dirt is removed. Place in a colander and set aside for 10 minutes to drain well. Stack the leaves and cut into 3-5cm thick strips.

Heat a large dry frying pan over medium heat. In batches, add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes or until it starts to wilt and turn bright green. Transfer to the colander and set aside to cool. Once cooled, use your hands to squeeze excess liquid from the spinach and place in a large bowl.

Meanwhile, place leek, onion and olive oil in a large frying pan and heat over medium heat. Cook, stirring, for 10-15 minutes or until onion has caramelised. Add green shallot and cook for 2 minutes or until just softened.
Add the onion mixture and dill to the bowl of spinach. Stir to combine. Set aside for 10-15 minutes or until it reaches room temperature.
Once your spinach mixture is cool, add ricotta and stir to combine. Crumble over feta and add egg. Season (do not add too much salt, as the feta is salty). Stir until well combined and set aside.
Preheat oven to 190C/170C fan forced. Combine the butter and extra olive oil in a bowl. Brush the base and side of a 30cm round baking pan with a little of the butter mixture.

Place filo sheets on a clean work surface. Using 7 sheets of filo pastry, take 1 filo sheet and place half inside the pan, leaving the other half draping outside the pan. Loosely scrunch the filo in the base of the pan. Repeat with 6 more sheets of filo, moving around the edge of the pan as you go, slightly overlapping the filo and scrunching each piece of filo inside the pan until the base and side are covered. Use a spoon to drizzle some of the butter mixture over the scrunched filo inside the pan.

Using 5 remaining sheets of filo pastry, loosely drape 1 at a time over the base of the pan on top of the scrunched filo until the base is evenly covered. Use a spoon to drizzle over some more of the butter mixture.
Spoon the spinach mixture into the pan and spread to evenly cover the entire base.

One at a time, loosely scrunch and drape the remaining filo sheets and arrange on top of the filling until covered completely. Use a spoon to drizzle over more of the butter mixture. One at a time, bring up and loosely drape all overhanging filo sheets over the top of the pie, to enclose. (Do not press down too hard on the pie.)

Using a sharp knife, cut the pie into wedges, cutting all the way to the bottom of the pan. Use a spoon to drizzle the filo top with the remaining butter mixture, making sure the mixture goes into the crevices. Sprinkle with sesame seeds, if using. Bake on the top rack of the oven for 1 hour or until golden and crispy. If your oven runs hot, place the pan on a lower rack to prevent burning. Serve the pie wedges while still warm.

recipes.title: Asian-style okra stir-fry recipe
recipes.description: Featuring fragrant ginger and garlic, our Asian-style okra stir-fry is a speedy side dish that your family and guests will love.
ingredients: 500g fresh okra, trimmed, cut diagonally into 3cm pieces
1 fresh long red chilli, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large deep frying pan over high heat. Add the onion, garlic and ginger, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until the onion starts to brown. Add the okra and stir-fry for 5-6 minutes or until the okra is bright green, just tender and just starting to char. Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute or until combined.
Serve the okra stir-fry scattered with chilli and sprinkled with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Mini filo cheese quiches recipe
recipes.description: With a gooey cheesy hidden centre, these mini filo cheese quiches are the ultimate party finger food.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan forced. Grease twelve 60ml (1/4 cup) muffin pans with oil spray.

Place 1 sheet of filo on a flat surface. Spray half the sheet with oil. Fold in half crossways. Spray half the sheet again with oil and fold in half. Cut the sheet in half crossways. Repeat with the remaining sheets (you should have 12 layered squares at the end). Line the muffin pan holes with the filo squares.
Whisk the eggs, cream and thyme in a jug until combined. Season with pepper. Cut the cheese into 1cm-thick slices. Cut each slice into 12 pieces.

Pour the egg mixture into the filo cases. Top each with a piece of cheese. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the filling is set and the pastry is golden. Sprinkle with chives and serve warm. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our mini filo cheese quiches recipe.

recipes.title: Cypriot grain salad-stuffed butternut pumpkin recipe
recipes.description:
This hearty salad hits all the notes of sweet, salty, tangy and chewy, with a bit of crunch from the walnuts. It is almost a no-waste recipe, with every part of the pumpkin being used, except for the stringy pulp. 
Why this is the best way to jazz up your pumpkin recipe this Christmas
Whether you’re hosting this Christmas, or simply just looking for something new to introduce to the table for a weekend lunch, this butternut pumpkin recipe is sure to become a new favourite.
The roasted flesh becomes part of the salad, the shells become vessels to hold the salad and the seeds can be roasted for a crunchy treat. The pumpkin skin is perfectly edible, so use up every last bit! 

When it comes to Christmas time, I love any recipes that help me get ahead when guests are coming over I love because it means you can spend time with your guests and not in the kitchen. You can cook the rice and quinoa up to 1 day in advance. Cover and store in the fridge. Warm gently in the microwave to take off the chill before assembling the salad. The pumpkin can be roasted up to 1 day in advance. Warm gently in the oven to take off the chill. If you are toasting the walnuts in advance, let them cool completely before storing in an airtight container.
What are the key ingredients in this grain salad-stuffed butternut pumpkin

Brown rice and quinoa: we have used a combination of these two grains, but you can swap those out for pearl barley, burghul, freekeh, wild rice (or any other type of rice). 
Cranberries and onions: soaking the cranberries and onion in lemon juice softens the dried fruit and also makes the onion slightly less pungent - as well as turning into a delightful shade of pink.
Butternut pumpkin: also known as butternut squash in Britain and the USA, is the perfect pumpkin to use because the skin holds its structure really well when you make this recipe ahead of your even, making it the perfect edible bowl!

Speaking of prepping ahead of time, why not get everything done early! Try this fennel-roasted twice-cooked pork belly, which you can make the day before your big event. Finish off your get-ahead prep with this condensed milk rocky road recipe, which can be stored in an airtight container for up to three weeks.

Additional recipe notes written by Holly Gerrard - Social and Content Producer.
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil, to brush
82.50 ml fresh continental parsley leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C/170°C fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper.

Scoop out the seeds and pulp from the cavity of each pumpkin half (see note). Place the pumpkin halves, cut-side up, on the prepared tray and brush the flesh with olive oil. Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes or until tender and lightly browned. In the last 10 minutes of cooking, spread the walnuts over another baking tray and place in the oven for 5 minutes or until lightly toasted. Remove the pumpkin and walnuts from the oven and set aside to cool. Coarsely chop the walnuts.

Meanwhile, cook the rice in a saucepan of boiling water for 35 minutes, adding the quinoa in the last 12 minutes of cooking. Drain and set aside to cool slightly. Combine the cranberries, onion and lemon juice in a bowl and set aside for 20 minutes to soften.

Carefully pour out and discard any liquid that may have accumulated in the pumpkin cavities then set aside until just warm. Use a metal spoon to scoop out enough of the flesh to leave an even, 1.5cm-thick shell. Cut or break the scooped out flesh into 2cm pieces. Arrange on the same lined tray and spray with oil. Roast for 15 minutes until dried out and slightly caramelised. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
To make the dressing, combine the olive oil red wine vinegar, balsamic vinegar and Dijon in a screw-top jar and season. Seal with the lid and shake until combined.

Place the rice mixture in a large bowl. Drizzle over the dressing, season and toss to combine. Add the cranberry mixture and any liquid left in the bowl, pumpkin pieces, walnuts, feta and parsley. Fold through until combined.

Spoon the salad into the pumpkin shells. (If the pumpkin shells are too full, serve the rest of the salad on the side.) To serve, scoop the salad from the shells then as it becomes more manageable, cut the pumpkin shells into pieces to serve as well.

recipes.title: One-pan caramelised tomato spaghetti recipe
recipes.description:
Crispy caramelised pieces of tomato packed pasta are what makes this Italian dish unique. This classic pasta dish is from the Puglia region of Italy and often called assassin’s spaghetti (spaghetti all’Assassina, in Italian) or killer spaghetti. This pasta can be controversial as it is a pasta dish that you literally burn to add the depth of flavour and to cook the pasta at the same time.
What is assassin’s spaghetti?
Assassin spaghetti sauce is often a rich tomato-based sauce with a hint of chilli. We have made our sauce a milder version but, if you like it more fiery, increase the heat to your liking. This pasta dish uses a similar technique to the making of risotto, adding ladlefuls of the tomato broth to the pasta and letting it absorb before adding more. 
How to caramelise pasta  
To ensure you get evenly crispy lengths of pasta when you start cooking, make sure you have a frying pan large enough to fit the pasta in the base. This will help your pasta caramelise more evenly. To ensure you get great caramelisation as it cooks, do not stir it too often (unlike risotto).
instructions: Place the tomato paste and 750ml (3 cups) water in a large saucepan. Season with salt and bring just to the boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to very low to keep warm.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a very large frying pan over high heat. Add the sause and chilli flakes. Bring to the boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 minutes or until the sauce thickens.

Lay the pasta in the tomato sauce mixture over the base of the pan (do not stir). Spoon the tomato sauce mixture around the pasta, and over the top, to cover. Cook, without stirring, for 2-3 minutes or until the pasta starts to caramelise underneath and char slightly.

Ladle about 125ml (1/2 cup) of the simmering tomato stock over the pasta. Use tongs to turn the pasta over. Cook, without stirring, for 1-2 minutes or until the liquid is completely absorbed and the pasta continues to caramelise underneath. Repeat, adding the remaining tomato stock, a ladleful at a time, and cooking for 1-2 minutes before adding the next ladleful, allowing the pasta to continue to caramelise between batches, or until al dente. This will take 15-17 minutes.
Divide pasta mixture among serving bowls and top with parmesan, to serve. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our One-pan caramelised tomato spaghetti recipe.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Norma recipe
recipes.description:
This simple pasta dish will definitely impress a crowd. Featuring tomatoes and eggplant, pasta alla Norma is a Sicilian staple. Every Sicilian nonna will have her particular secret touches, but the main elements remain the same. The story of the name is that when the Sicilian writer Nino Martoglio tried the dish, he declared it “a real Norma”.  Norma is an opera, composed by fellow Sicilian Vincenzo Bellini, so Nino meant that he considered it a masterpiece. See if you agree! 
How to make the best traditional pasta alla Norma recipe
Like many of our favourite Italian pasta recipes, this traditional Sicilian pasta alla Norma recipe is super simple, getting its delicious fresh flavours from quality ingredients. However, getting your hands on fresh produce all the time can be difficult, so we’ve replicated the traditional classic flavours by using good canned tomatoes. Yes, bursting ripe tomatoes (which Sicily is famous for) are traditional, but canned tomatoes are consistent and reliably flavoursome. A pinch of sugar can balance out the slight acidity of canned tomatoes, so taste and season accordingly. 
Another way we’ve turned this classic Italian pasta into a more accessible pasta alla Norma recipe is by salting the eggplant. Salting eggplants was a go-to step a few decades ago and some sources say that it’s not necessary anymore because the bitterness has been bred out of modern varieties. I’ve found that if the eggplant is slightly older (which large ones may be), they can still be a little bitter, so adding a bit of salt doesn’t hurt. Plus, I’ve never known an Italian to shy away from a pinch or two of salt!
Speaking of eggplant, when you fry it up, it will initially absorb all the oil and the pan may appear quite dry. Practice patience for a few minutes because the vegetable will begin to release the oil again, becoming tender and golden brown. Don’t add extra oil because the eggplant will go all soggy!
For the pasta shape, I’ve used rigatoni, which is the traditional Sicilian choice, but any similar pasta shape can be used. The tubes catch the sauce inside and cling to the ridges for a flavoursome mouthful every time. If you only have spaghetti in your cupboard though, use that!

If you’re looking for more simple pasta recipe inspiration, try this creamy pumpkin and mushroom pasta recipe or another of our best, traditional Italian pastas with this version of carbonara florentine.
ingredients: 2 large basil sprigs, plus extra leaves to serve
Coarsely grated ricotta salata, to serve
instructions: Place the eggplant on a tray and sprinkle generously with salt. Set aside for 20 minutes for the salt to draw out any bitter juices. Rinse eggplant under cold running water and pat dry with paper towel. Cut into cubes.

Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook the eggplant for 4 minutes, turning often, until soft and golden brown. Use a slotted spoon to remove from the pan and set aside. Drain all but 1 tbsp oil from the pan.

Add the tomato, garlic and basil to the pan. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until thickened and reduced slightly. Season with salt, freshly ground black pepper and a pinch of sugar, if needed.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large saucepan of salted boiling water according to packet directions or until al dente. Drain well.
Remove garlic and basil from tomato sauce. Add the pasta and eggplant to the pan, and fold to combine.
Serve pasta immediately topped with ricotta salata and extra basil.

recipes.title: Best-ever yellow rice recipe
recipes.description: A chilled fragrant rice, perfect to pair with any barbecue. Cooked with a blend of spices including cumin and coriander, and infused with a vegetable broth for a rich taste. Enhanced with the freshness of cilantro, toasted pine nuts, and golden raisins before it hits the table.
instructions: Place rice, stock, curry powder and turmeric in a medium saucepan and bring to the boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff rice mixture with a fork.
Meanwhile, heat half the butter in a small frying pan over medium heat. Add almonds and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 minutes or until golden.
Stir almonds, remaining butter, sultanas and parsley through the warm rice. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Easy Turkish beef pasta recipe
recipes.description: This easy Turkish beef mince pasta would have to be the best new pasta dish on my 2025 weeknight repertoire.
ingredients: 500g No Added Hormone Beef 3 Star Regular Mince
Chopped fresh continental parsley, to sprinkle
instructions: Cook pasta in a saucepan of salted boiling water following packet directions or until al dente. Drain well.

Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add beef and cook, breaking up the mince with a wooden spoon, for 5 minutes or until just browned. Add onion and reduce the heat to medium. Cook, stirring, for 4-5 minutes or until the onion has softened. Add garlic, tomato paste, paprika and cayenne, then cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until the mixture darkens slightly.
To make the yoghurt sauce, combine yoghurt, garlic and lemon juice in a bowl. Season.
To make the spiced butter, melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Add paprika and cayenne, and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds or until aromatic. Remove from the heat.

Place the pasta in a large serving bowl. Top with the beef, yoghurt sauce, spiced butter, cucumber and tomato. Sprinkle with feta and parsley. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our easy Turkish beef pasta recipe.

recipes.title: Quick French onion chicken pie recipe
recipes.description:
There’s something to be said for the joy that a simple chicken pie can bring to the table – it’s a dinner that taste.com.au members love to share with their families. This was one reimagined dish we knew we had to include as part of our Savvy Dinner Plan, and I have a hunch that my quick French onion chicken pie, with its creamy vegetable and chicken filling, will soon become a firm family favourite. 
This is no humble pie. It really ticks all the boxes: it’s cost-effective, uncomplicated, quick to make, and is filled with wholesome fare. Plus, its picture-perfect pastry top makes it look too good to eat. (Almost).
How to make my budget-friendly quick French onion chicken pie: key ingredient swaps
Like all good French-inspired recipes, this one is enhanced with buttery flavours. I used Coles Simply Unsalted Butter to pan-fry the vegetables – adding a touch of richness with just one savvy ingredient.
I also chose to buy separate frozen vegetables (rather than a mixed bag) to not only bulk up the filling, but also ensure there’d be plenty of vegies in the freezer you can use for future dinners (think speedy corn or pea fritters, for example). 
And putting the French flavour in this French onion pie is my go-to shortcut ingredient: French onion soup mix. This low-cost ingredient adds further depth of flavour and also allows the pie sauce to thicken and become silky smooth. 
What’s the Savvy Dinner Plan?
The taste.com.au food team has redesigned our most searched-for family dinner recipes to help you stretch your grocery budget further. By making savvy ingredient swaps and switching up how you plan and cook, the Savvy Dinner Plan can help shave dollars off your favourite dinners, without compromising on flavour.
Not a planner? You can still save. Check out all our Savvy Dinner Plan recipes and pick the perfect dish for you.
For instructions on how to prep ahead, see the notes below the recipe.
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, just thawed
40g pkt Simply French Onion Soup Mix
½ x hot Classic Homestyle Roast Chicken, meat shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 220C/200C fan forced. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Cut pastry into 16 equal squares. Arrange on the prepared tray, corners slightly overlapping in a decorative pattern (see photo) large enough to cover top of a 2L (8 cup) square or rectangular pie dish. Brush with egg. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden and puffed.

Meanwhile, melt the butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and carrot, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until onion is soft. Add the mushroom, peas and corn. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until mushroom starts to soften.

Add flour and stir to coat vegetables. Stir in soup mix. Stir in cream, then milk, until well combined. Stir in chicken and season with freshly ground black pepper. Simmer, stirring constantly, for 5-10 minutes or until mixture is thickened and chicken is heated through (if mixture is too thick, stir in a little extra milk or water).
Transfer chicken mixture to the pie dish and top with decorative pastry, to serve.

recipes.title: One-pot cheesy French onion meatballs recipe
recipes.description: These quick and easy one-pan weeknight meatballs, packed with cheese and French onion flavours, prove that creating a comforting dinner doesn’t need to be time-consuming!
ingredients: Small thyme sprigs, extra, to serve
instructions: Heat oil in a large, heavy-based, ovenproof frying pan over medium heat. Add meatballs and cook, tossing occasionally, for 3-5 minutes or until golden. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.

Reduce the pan heat to medium-low. Add onion and thyme, then cook, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes or until onion is soft and light golden. Add garlic and sugar, and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds or until aromatic. Add gravy powder and stir until well combined. Gradually add water and Worcestershire sauce, stirring constantly until liquid comes to the boil.
Return the meatballs to the pan. Cook, turning halfway through, for 10 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked through and the gravy thickens slightly.

Preheat an oven grill to high. Sprinkle cheese on top of the meatball mixture and grill for 3 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Sprinkle with extra thyme sprigs. Serve with crusty bread alongside. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our one-pot cheesy French onion meatballs.

recipes.title: 5-ingredient chicken pie with Parmentier potato topping recipe
recipes.description: With only 5 ingredients and just 5 minutes prep time, this tasty chicken pie deserves a starring role on your midweek menu.
ingredients: 500g pkt Chef Inspired Parmentier Potatoes With Herb Butter Plus Garlic
1 Coles RSPCA Approved Whole Chicken Roast, skin and bones, discarded, meat roughly shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C/180C fan forced. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Arrange potatoes on the prepared tray. Roast, tossing halfway, for 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook frozen vegetables, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 minutes or until vegetables start to soften. Add chicken, carbonara sauce and 125ml (1/2 cup) water. Season. Stir to combine. Transfer mixture to an 8-cup (2L) baking dish.

Evenly spoon potatoes over the chicken mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the potato is golden and crunchy, and the pie is heated through. Serve. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our 5-ingredient chicken pie with Parmentier potato topping.

recipes.title: 5-ingredient cheesy Mexican stuffed chicken breasts recipe
recipes.description: Give humble chicken breasts a scrumptious Mexican makeover with just 5 ingredients that smack with flavour – it will become your favourite quick-and-easy midweek dinner.
ingredients: 4 slices British Chilli Cheddar Slices, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 190C/170C fan-forced. Drain peppers, reserving 1 tbsp marinating oil. Slice peppers.
Cut slits into each chicken breast, about 1 1/2cm apart, being careful not to cut the whole way through. Push peppers and coriander leaves into the cuts.
Reserve 1/4 cup salsa. Stir water into remaining salsa and spoon over the base of a greased 21cm x 35cm roasting pan. Arrange chicken breasts on top. Drizzle with reserved oil and season.

Bake chicken for 15 minutes. Drizzle chicken with reserved salsa and top with cheese slices (breaking where needed to completely cover top of breasts). Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through. Serve sprinkled with coriander sprigs.

recipes.title: BLAT loaded pasta salad recipe
recipes.description: We've turned the classic, Aussie family-favourite bacon, lettuce, avocado and tomato sandwich into a fully-loaded pasta salad, perfect for sharing with friends and family.
ingredients: 4 Made Thin Sliced Streaky Bacon Rashers, chopped
400g punnet tomato medley, small tomatoes halved, large tomatoes quartered
instructions: Cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water following packet directions. Drain. Refresh under cold water. Drain well.
Meanwhile, heat a frying pan over high heat. Cook bacon, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp. Drain on paper towel.
Place tomato, avocado, salad leaves, basil, pasta and bacon in a large serving bowl. Toss to combine.
Place oil, vinegar and mustard in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Whisk to combine. Add dressing to salad. Toss to combine. Sprinkle with parmesan. Serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy bacon and veggie rice slice recipe
recipes.description: This cheesy slice keeps well making it the perfect cook-ahead lunch box filler. Serve it alongside a fresh autumn salad and you'll have a meal that is not only delicious, but quick and easy to make, too!
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into florets, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C. Line a 16cm x 26cm (base measurement) slice pan with baking paper, allowing the 2 long sides to overhang.

Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and bacon, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until light golden. Add garlic and cook, stirring, for 30 secs. Transfer to a large bowl. Set aside to cool slightly.
Heat the rice following packet directions. Add to the bacon mixture in the bowl with the sweet potato, broccoli, peas and 1 cup (120g) cheese. Stir until combined. Fold in the egg. Season.
Spoon the mixture into the prepared pan, pressing down firmly. Smooth the surface. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Lightly sprinkle with paprika, if desired.
Bake for 30 mins or until set and golden brown. Set aside in the pan for 5 mins to cool slightly. Cut into pieces. Serve with salad and chutney.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar veggie wraps
recipes.description: This chicken wrap is packed with fresh salad and a delicious creamy Caesar dressing.
ingredients: 2 corn cobs, husks and silks removed
4 RSPCA Approved Chicken Thigh Fillets (about 550g), trimmed
4 White Soft Wraps, lightly toasted on barbecue
3 heads baby gem lettuce, leaves separated
1 Lebanese cucumber, cut into thin wedges
instructions: To make the dressing, in a blender, blend yoghurt, parmesan, lemon juice, mustard, oil, anchovies and garlic until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Prepare a barbecue for medium-high heat. Coat corn with 2 teaspoons oil. Season with salt and pepper. Barbecue, turning occasionally, for 18 mins or until charred. Cut kernels off cobs into a bowl.
Meanwhile, coat chicken with the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper. Barbecue for 5-6 mins each side or until cooked through. Set aside for 5 mins to rest. Thinly slice chicken.
Lay the wraps on a work surface. Top with lettuce, corn, chicken and cucumber. Fold bottom third over filling and roll up. Drizzle dressing into wraps as desired and serve with tomatoes.

recipes.title: 5-minute dense bean tabouli salad recipe
recipes.description: This easy 5-minute dense bean tabouli salad is perfect for work lunches or a light, flavour-packed dinner.
ingredients: 1 bunch parsley, stems trimmed, cut in half
3 green shallots, each cut into 4 pieces
420g can Red Kidney Beans, drained, rinsed
instructions: Place half the parsley, half the cucumbers and half shallots in a food processor. Top with remaining parsley, remaining cucumber and remaining shallots. Process until finely chopped, scraping down the side of the processor halfway through. Transfer to a large bowl.

Top with tomatoes, butter beans, kidney beans and chickpeas. Drizzle with lemon juice and oil. Season and toss to combine. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our 5-minute dense bean tabouli salad recipe.

recipes.title: Tuna, green bean and beetroot salad recipe
recipes.description: It only takes 10 minutes to whip up this delicious salad. With feta, beetroot and tangy dijon dressing, lunches really don't get much better than this. Did we mention it's low cal, gluten-free and full of protein too?
ingredients: 100g cooked baby beetroot, cut into wedges
95g can tuna in olive oil, drained, flaked
instructions: Cook the green beans in a steamer basket over a saucepan of boiling water for 3 minutes or until bright green and tender crisp. Refresh under cold running water. Drain.

Combine the green beans, beetroot, tuna, salad leaves and feta in a serving bowl. Whisk balsamic, lemon juice and mustard in a jug. Drizzle the dressing over the salad. Scatter over the hemp seeds just before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Waldorf salad wraps recipe
recipes.description: Just like the retro salad, these healthy wraps are packed with creamy chicken and lots of fresh veg. Almonds give the filling extra crunch, while apple adds sweet balance. They're quick, easy, low-cal and low-fat.
ingredients: 2 tsp finely chopped roasted unsalted almonds
50g cooked chicken breast (or skinless rotisserie chicken), shredded
instructions: Combine the kale slaw (reserve dressing from the packet for another use), apple and almonds in a bowl. Combine the yoghurt and lemon juice in a separate bowl.
Top the wrap with the chicken, yoghurt mixture and slaw mixture. Roll up to enclose filling.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and quinoa nourish bowl recipe
recipes.description: This bright vegetarian salad bowl is loaded with pumpkin, egg, quinoa and cabbage. This dish makes for a healthy and easy lunch or light dinner.
ingredients: 600g butternut pumpkin, peeled, deseeded, cut into 1.5cm pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Arrange pumpkin in a single layer on prepared tray. Sprinkle with cumin and lightly spray with oil. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden and tender.

Meanwhile, combine the vinegar, honey and a large pinch of salt in a bowl. Add the cabbage and stir to combine. Set aside for 5 minutes to pickle. Steam, boil or microwave the beans until tender. Drain well.

Combine the lemon juice, oil and tahini in a small bowl until smooth. Divide the quinoa, pumpkin, beans and cabbage among serving bowls. Top each with a poached egg then drizzle over the tahini dressing to serve.

recipes.title: Japanese chicken noodle salad jar recipe
recipes.description: Prep the night before and enjoy this quick and healthy Japanese salad.
ingredients: 1 small carrot, peeled, cut into thin ribbons
instructions: Place the pasta, edamame and carrot in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water and set aside for 5 minutes or until the pasta is softened. Drain and refresh under cold running water. Drain.

Layer the carrot, pasta, edamame, spinach and chicken in a 500ml (2 cup) jar or airtight container. Combine soy sauce, oil and chilli in a bowl then pour into jar. Seal and place in the fridge until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Tuna and kale rice salad with sesame soy dressing recipe
recipes.description: With only 5 ingredients and ready in 5 minutes, this quick and easy lunch idea is also healthy. Tick, tick, tick!
ingredients: 95g can tuna in olive oil, drained, flaked
instructions: Microwave rice for 30 seconds or until heated through.
Combine rice, tuna and kale slaw in a bowl. Add sesame oil and soy sauce and toss to combine.

recipes.title: Avocado pitas with spiced chickpeas
recipes.description: Serve these spiced chickpeas, avocado and chorizo pitas as a light meal with fresh mint leaves and lemon wedges.
ingredients: 4 small pieces wholemeal pita bread or flatbread
1 large ripe avocado, stoned, peeled, coarsely chopped
1/2 large ripe avocado, extra, stoned, peeled, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a chargrill on high. Brush the bread with half the oil and cook on the grill, in batches, for 1-2 mins each side or until lightly charred. Divide among serving plates.

Cook the chorizo on the grill for 1 min each side or until charred. Transfer to a large heatproof bowl. Combine the chickpeas, paprika, cumin, coriander and remaining oil in a bowl. Cook on the grill, stirring, until heated through. Add to the chorizo in the bowl.
Place the chopped avocado, lemon juice and half the yoghurt in a food processor. Season. Process until the mixture is smooth.
Spread the bread evenly with the avocado mixture. Top with sliced avocado. Spoon over the chorizo mixture and top with dollops of the remaining yoghurt. Drizzle with the pesto. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cheesy vegie-ball subs
recipes.description: Classic meatball subs get a clever vegie twist with our easy recipe.
ingredients: 2 x 400g cans chickpeas, rinsed, drained well
20g (1/4 cup) fresh breadcrumbs (made from day-old bread)
instructions: Use a box grater to coarsely grate the eggplant. Place in a colander and set aside, squeezing often, for 15 minutes.
Process the chickpeas, half the onion and half the garlic in a food processor until a coarse paste forms. Transfer to a large bowl. Stir in eggplant, parsley, breadcrumbs, flour and egg. Season.

Preheat the oven to 220C/200C fan forced and line a baking tray with baking paper. Roll tablespoonfuls of eggplant mixture into balls. Place on prepared tray. Bake, turning halfway, for 20 minutes or until the vegie-balls are golden and firm to the touch.

Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat. Add the remaining onion and garlic and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes or until softened. Stir in the chilli flakes, then passata. Season. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes or until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the vegie-balls and set aside.

Preheat the grill on high. Cut the rolls down the middle, taking care not to cut through. Place, cut side down, on a lined baking tray. Grill for 1-2 minutes or until lightly toasted. Turn rolls over and fill with the vegie-ball mixture. Sprinkle with the mozzarella. Grill for 1-2 minutes or until mozzarella starts to melt. Sprinkle with basil.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and fetta snails
recipes.description: Roll up these high fibre, vegetarian scrolls for a budget-friendly lunch the whole family will enjoy.
ingredients: 500g orange sweet potato, peeled, cut into 2.5cm pieces
250g packet Uncle Ben's® Microwave Brown Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan-forced. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Place sweet potato on 1 prepared tray. Drizzle with 1/2 the oil. Sprinkle with seasoning. Toss to coat. Bake for 25 minutes or until tender. Roughly mash (see note).

Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook garlic and spinach, stirring, for 2 minutes or until just wilted. Add onion and rice. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until heated through. Remove from heat. Transfer to a large bowl. Add sweet potato, fetta and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Cool for 20 minutes.

Place 1 sheet of filo pastry on a flat surface. Spray with oil. Place another sheet on top. Spray with oil. Place 1⁄4 of the sweet potato mixture along 1 long edge and roll pastry up to enclose filling. Curl log to form a coil. Carefully place on remaining prepared tray. Repeat with remaining filo, oil and sweet potato mixture to make 4 coils. Spray coils with olive oil. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for 25 minutes until pastry is golden. Serve warm or cold, with mixed salad leaves.

recipes.title: Tuna and hummus corn cakes
recipes.description: Make lunch al desko easy with these tasty corn cakes with tuna.
ingredients: 125g can tuna slices in olive oil, drained
instructions: Spread hummus over corn thins. Top with cucumber, tomato, tuna and mint leaves. Season with black pepper. Serve.

recipes.title: Ham and pineapple poke bowl
recipes.description: Use your leftover ham to make a healthy ham and pineapple poke bowl, perfect for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 37.50 gm sesame seeds, plus extra toasted seeds to serve
1/2 pineapple, peeled, cored, cut into 2cm pieces
1/2 x 454g packet frozen edamame, thawed, peeled
instructions: Place ham in a dish. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons ponzu sauce. Turn ham to coat in sauce. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, if time permits.

Rinse and drain rice 3 times. Place rice and 1½ cups water in a saucepan over medium heat. Cover. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, for 12 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat. Stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Transfer rice to a large ceramic dish. Using a spatula, stir rice and break up lumps. Gradually add seasoning, lifting and turning rice. Set aside for 10 minutes to cool. Stir in onion.

Meanwhile, place sesame seeds on a plate. Remove ham from dish, discarding sauce. Press ham in sesame seeds to coat all over. Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Spray ham with the oil. Cook for 2 minutes each side or until sesame seeds are toasted. Transfer to a chopping board.

Cut ham into 2cm pieces. Place in a bowl. Add pineapple. Toss to combine. Arrange rice, cabbage, avocado, edamame, cucumber and ham mixture in serving bowls. Whisk wasabi and remaining ponzu sauce and together in a small bowl. Drizzle over bowls. Serve sprinkled with extra sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Super green rice salad
recipes.description: It only takes 20 minutes to throw together this nutritious super green rice salad with ham.
ingredients: 400.00 gm cold cooked brown medium-grain rice (see notes)
instructions: Make Dressing. Process basil, parsley, chives, garlic, anchovies, lemon rind and juice in a small food processor until finely chopped. Add mayonnaise. Process until well combined. Season with pepper.
Place rice, salad leaves, capsicum, avocado, sprouts and ham in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Transfer to serving bowls. Serve with dressing.

recipes.title: Toasted salmon burrito
recipes.description: Give your dinner an omega-3 boost with these 17-minute Mexican-inspired salmon burritos filled with fresh vegetables and garlic aioli.
instructions: Cut salmon into 1cm slices. Place spice mix and sesame seeds in a large sealable bag. Add salmon. Seal. Toss to coat.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Spray with oil. Cook salmon, in batches, for 1-2 minutes each side, until cooked.
Top each wrap with lettuce, carrot, cheddar, avocado, salmon, coriander and aioli. Wrap up to enclose.
Cook the burritos, 1 at a time, on a preheated sandwich press for 1-2 minutes, until crisp and light golden. Remove and cut in half. Drizzle with a little more aioli.

recipes.title: Curried chicken and apple slaw sandwiches
recipes.description: The canteen won't stand a chance next to this curried chicken and apple slaw sandwich.
ingredients: 1 Granny Smith apple, halved, cored, cut into matchsticks
1 small carrot, cut into long thin matchsticks
8 thick slices soy and linseed bread
instructions: Combine chicken, curry powder, mayonnaise, chives and 1/2 the juice in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine apple, cabbage, carrot, oil and remaining juice in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Place 1/2 of the bread slices on a board. Top evenly with chicken mixture, then apple slaw and mint. Sandwich with remaining bread slices. Cut in half. Serve.

recipes.title: Pea and chickpea falafel with whipped garlic fetta
recipes.description: Create a high fibre, delicious vegetarian main with these easy pea and chickpea falafels served with whipped garlic fetta.
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil, for shallow-frying
4 warmed small pita bread, to serve
18.20 gm extra virgin olive oil, plus extra to drizzle
instructions: Place peas, chickpeas, onion, parsley, garlic, tahini, cumin and coriander in a food processor. Process until just combined. Add flour. Process until mixture is almost smooth. Transfer to a bowl. Cover. Refrigerate for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile to make the whipped garlic fetta, place fetta, garlic, lemon juice and oil in a small food processor bowl. Process until smooth and combined. Season well with pepper. Transfer to a serving bowl. Drizzle with extra oil.

Stir bicarbonate of soda into falafel mixture. Using damp hands, roll 2 level tablespoons of falafel mixture into rough ovals and flatten slightly (mixture will be quite soft). Sprinkle one side of falafels with sesame seeds. Place on a plate.

Add enough oil to a large frying pan to reach 1cm up side of pan. Heat over medium heat. Cook falafel, in batches, for 1 to 2 minutes each side or until well-browned and cooked through. Drain on paper towel.
Serve falafel with whipped fetta, pita bread, salad leaves, radish, mint and lemon wedges, with a drizzle of extra oil.

recipes.title: Spiced salmon with chickpea, broccoli and rocket salad and yoghurt dressing
recipes.description: Try this spiced salmon and chickpea salad for a satisfying low-calorie and gluten-free meal.
ingredients: 1 large head (about 400g) broccoli, trimmed, cut into small florets
2.50 gm ground cumin, plus 2.50 gm, extra
2 (200g each) Fresh Tassie Salmon Skin on fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C /180C fan forced. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Place the broccoli on prepared tray. Spray lightly with olive oil. Roast for 10-12 minutes or until golden and tender.
Meanwhile, combine the cumin, paprika and coriander in a small bowl. Sprinkle the spice mixture over both sides of the salmon.
Combine the roasted broccoli, celery, shallot, chickpeas and rocket in a large bowl. Combine the yoghurt, lemon juice and extra cumin in a small bowl and set aside.
Spray a chargrill or barbecue with oil and heat over a high heat. Cook the salmon for 2-3 minutes each side or until cooked to your liking. Set aside to cool slightly and break into large chunks.
Divide salad between plates. Top each with salmon. Drizzle with the yoghurt dressing.

recipes.title: Shaved ham, beetroot dip and salad wholegrain wrap
recipes.description: Create a healthy, low calorie wrap with this satisfying ham and vegetable wrap.
ingredients: 20g baby spinach, rocket or mixed salad leaves
instructions: Place wrap on a clean work surface. Spread the dip down the middle of the wrap. Top with carrot, ham, cucumber and spinach.
Wrap to enclose the filling. Serve with mixed salad leaves.

recipes.title: Crispy Chinese five-spice fish in plum sauce
recipes.description: Crisp up your fish with Chinese five-spice and then serve it with sweet plum sauce. You won't believe it's ready in just over half an hour.
ingredients: 600g firm white fish fillets, cut into 6cm pieces
1 large red capsicum, cut into 3cm pieces
3 green onions, cut into 4cm lengths, plus extra sliced onion to serve
instructions: Combine flour and five-spice powder in a large snap-lock bag.

Pour enough vegetable oil into a large, heavy-based saucepan to reach 2cm up side of pan. Heat over medium-high heat. Add fish to flour in bag. Seal. Shake gently to coat. Remove 1/3 of the fish from flour mixture, shaking off excess, and place in oil. Shallowfry, turning, for 4 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towel. Repeat with remaining fish, in 2 batches.

Heat sesame oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add capsicum. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add broccolini and onion. Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables are just tender. Add plum sauce, soy sauce and lemon juice. Bring to the boil. Add fish. Stir-fry, tossing gently, for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through.
Divide rice among serving bowls. Top with the fish mixture and sprinkle with extra onion. Serve.

recipes.title: Salmon and potato patties with mango salad
recipes.description: This low fat salmon and potato patty recipe is definitely one worth breaking out for warmer weather. The crunchy breadcrumb coating adds texture and the mango side salad brings all the freshness you need.
instructions: Place potatoes in large saucepan of water. Cover. Bring to the boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium. Boil for 12 to 15 minutes or until almost tender. Drain. Rinse under cold water. Drain well.
Place potato in a large bowl. Roughly mash with the back of a spoon.

Drain salmon. Remove and discard bones. Roughly flake. Add to potato. Add the egg, green onion, flour, dill, curry powder and salt. Season with pepper. Mix until just combined. Shape 1/4 cup mixture into a patty. Repeat with remaining mixture. Toss patties in breadcrumbs to coat.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook patties, in 2 batches, for 2 minutes each side or until golden and heated through. Drain on paper towel.
Meanwhile, toss rocket, mango, cucumber and red onion in a bowl. Drizzle with dressing. Serve patties with salad.

recipes.title: Air fryer sausage rolls recipe
recipes.description: Say goodbye to soggy bottoms! This easy air fryer sausage rolls recipe makes perfectly golden, crispy and flaky party bites in 15 minutes.
ingredients: 40.00 ml finely chopped fresh continental parsley leaves
3 sheets frozen puff pastry, just thawed
instructions: Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper.
Place sausage mince, beef mince, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, parsley, tomato sauce and egg in a large bowl. Use clean hands to mix until well combined.

One at a time, place 1 sheet of pastry on a flat surface. Cut in half. Arrange one-sixth of the mince mixture in log shape down the centre of each piece of pastry. Roll up to enclose the filling, brushing the pastry edge with extra whisked egg to secure. Cut each roll into 6 equal portions. Place the sausage rolls, seam-side down, on the lined trays. Place in the fridge for 30 minutes to chill.

Brush the top of each sausage roll with a little of the remaining whisked egg. Use a small, sharp knife to pierce the top of each roll a few times. In batches, place sausage rolls in an air fryer basket, making sure to leave 2cm in between each roll to allow it to puff up. Cook at 200°C for 12-15 minutes or until the pastry is golden and the filling is cooked through. Serve warm with tomato sauce alongside.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine cob loaf recipe (super tasty!)
recipes.description: Cob loaf meets quiche Lorraine in this brilliant, nostalgic hybrid recipe that’s the perfect shared dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan forced. Line a large baking tray with baking paper.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add onion and bacon. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until browned. Remove pan from the heat. Cool for 5 minutes.
Cut one-third of the bread from the top of the cob loaf and discard. Leaving a 2cm-thick edge, remove soft bread from the centre of the cob (see notes).

Whisk eggs, 1/2 cup cheese, cream and flour in a bowl. Stir in three-quarters of the bacon mixture. Season. Pour egg mixture into cob and sprinkle with remaining bacon mixture and remaining cheese. Place cob on the prepared tray and bake for 45 minutes or until the egg mixture has set. Stand for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with chives, if using, then cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Easy turkey meatball recipe (bake, grill, pan-fry or air-fry!)
recipes.description: This super-versatile, easy turkey meatball dinner can be cooked 4 simple ways for perfectly moist results!
ingredients: 40.00 ml finely chopped fresh continental parsley leaves
Fresh continental parsley leaves, extra, to garnish
instructions: To grill meatballs, preheat an oven grill to medium-high. Line a baking tray with sides with foil. Spray with oil.

Place turkey, breadcrumbs, onion, parsley, thyme, parmesan and egg in a bowl. Season. Using your hand, mix until just combined. Roll tablespoonfuls of the mixture into balls and arrange on the prepared tray. Spray with oil.

Grill meatballs for 4-5 minutes or until golden. Turn meatballs and grill for a further 2-3 minutes or until cooked through. Place on a serving plate. Sprinkle with extra parsley and serve with yoghurt.

recipes.title: Mayak eggs recipe (Korean marinated eggs)
recipes.description:
“I’ve always loved eggs and bold Korean flavours and there’s a Korean burger spot in Brisbane I’m obsessed with,” says Ana Murphy. “Cooking Korean barbecue with friends inspired me to try making mayak eggs at home. They’re simple to make, addictive and full of flavour.”
Why we love mayak eggs (Korean marinated eggs)
Mayak eggs means ‘drug eggs’ in Korean, which makes them dangerously addictive and, once you taste them, it’ll be obvious to see why. 
The soy, garlic, chilli, onion and sesame marinade transforms your everyday boiled eggs into something savoury, sweet, a little spicy (if you keep the chilli in) and deeply umami. 

The best part? The jammy yolks soak up the marinade, giving you a creamy, silky, flavour-packed bite every time.
How you serve these eggs is up to you. Enjoy them just as eggs or, as we have done in the recipe, pop them on some steamed rice or even in a ramen or on a bowl of noodles. They’re also great on avocado toast or in a salad. One thing is for sure – you’re guaranteed to adore mayak eggs every which way! 
Key tips on making mayak eggs (Korean marinated eggs)

Remember to make these eggs ahead of time as they need to marinate in the fridge for 6-12 hours.
Add a splash of mirin or a dash of gochugaru (Korean chilli flakes) to the marinade to customise the flavour, if you like.
You can adjust the amount of chilli to suit your taste, noting that green chillies contain less heat than red chillies.
Plunging the eggs into iced water is really important for this dish – it stops the cooking process and ensures the yolks stay soft and gooey, rather than rubbery.


Popular Korean cuisine has something for everyone. We have more than 130 recipes to tempt you.
Originally submitted by Ana Murphy and professionally tested by taste team recipe developer Tracy Rutherford. Intro and additional notes compiled by food writer Natasha Shaw.
ingredients: Green shallots, green part only, thinly sliced diagonally, to serve
2 green shallots, white part only, finely chopped
1 small brown onion, very finely chopped
1-2 fresh red bird’s-eye chillies or green chillies, sliced (optional)
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Gently lower eggs into the water and boil for exactly 6 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the eggs to a bowl of iced water to stop the cooking process. Set aside for 10 minutes or until the eggs are completely cooled.
Meanwhile, to make the marinade, combine soy sauce, honey, garlic, green shallot, onion, chilli (if using), sesame oil, sesame seeds and vinegar in a bowl. Stir in water.
Tap the larger end of an egg to break the shell, then carefully peel. Repeat with remaining eggs.
Add the peeled eggs to the marinade and turn to coat. Cover and place in the fridge, turning once or twice so the eggs colour and marinate evenly, for 6-12 hours.
To serve, cut the eggs in half lengthways and arrange yolk-side up on top of steamed rice. Drizzle with some of the marinade. Sprinkle with a little green shallot

recipes.title: Low-calorie mango chicken noodles recipe
recipes.description: Light, bright, and fresh, this low-calorie mango chicken noodles recipe will quickly become your go-to lunch.
ingredients: 1 long fresh red chilli, deseeded, thinly sliced
125.00 ml fresh herb sprigs (such as mint or coriander)
instructions: Combine oil, maple syrup, 1 1/2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp ginger and 1 tsp fish sauce in a shallow dish. Add chicken and turn to coat. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes to marinate.
Meanwhile, cook noodles in a saucepan of boiling water following packet directions. Refresh under cold running water. Drain.
Heat a large, non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to a chopping board and thickly slice.
Meanwhile, place mango, half the chilli and the remaining lime juice, vinegar, ginger and fish sauce in a small food processor or blender and process until smooth.
Divide the noodles, cabbage, edamame, cucumber, herbs and chicken among serving bowls. Drizzle over the mango dressing and sprinkle with the remaining chilli to serve.

recipes.title: Mini Caesar salad parmesan cups recipe
recipes.description: Introducing your summer entertaining bestie: Caesar salad served in parmesan cups.
ingredients: 90g (1½ cups) finely shredded baby gem lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C/170°C fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Place 2 shot glasses, base-side up, on a clean surface.

Pile 4 slightly heaped tablespoons of parmesan on the prepared tray, leaving a 4cm gap between each pile to allow for spreading. Use your fingers to shape piles into flat 8cm-diameter rounds. Bake for 7-8 minutes or until bubbling and lightly golden. Let parmesan discs cool for a few seconds or until they start to firm up around the edges.

Use an offset spatula to carefully transfer 2 parmesan discs to the glasses, draping them over the bases. Use your hands to gently press and form a cup shape. Hold the cups in place for a few seconds to firm up, then lift off and place base-side up on a wire rack to cool completely. Repeat with remaining 2 parmesan discs. (If you find the discs are too firm, return the tray to the oven to soften slightly before transferring to the shot glasses to shape.)
Repeat with remaining parmesan to make 16 parmesan cups in total (you can re-use the same baking paper each time).
Cook bacon in a frying pan over medium heat, turning, for 5 minutes or until crisp and golden. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel to drain. Cool completely, then finely chop.

Combine lettuce and avocado in a bowl. Add the dressing and toss to coat. Divide mixture evenly among the parmesan cups and sprinkle with bacon. Season with freshly ground black pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crispy air fryer sushi rice paper rolls recipe
recipes.description: Love sushi rolls but crave the silky chewiness of rice paper rolls? This genius fusion recipe combines the best of both worlds, plus they’re air-fried to crispy perfection and served with a zesty mayo dipping sauce.
ingredients: 2 x 185g cans tuna in springwater, drained, flaked
1 sheet Sushi Nori, cut into 8 rectangles
1 large carrot, halved crossways, thinly sliced lengthways
instructions: Prepare rice according to packet instructions. Combine tuna and mayonnaise in a bowl.

Fill a large bowl with warm water. Dip 1 rice paper sheet into the water for 15 seconds or until soft. (Be careful not to let it get too soft. It should be soft, but firm enough to handle.) Transfer to a board.

Place a piece of nori in the centre of the rice paper round. Place 1/4 cup of sushi rice on the nori and top with some of the tuna mixture, carrot, shallot and avocado. Fold in the opposite sides of the rice paper round and roll up to enclose the filling. Transfer to a large tray or board. Repeat to make 8 rolls in total.
Preheat an air fryer at 200C for 5 minutes. Spray rolls with oil. In batches, place rolls seam-side down in the air fryer basket and cook at 200C for 10 minutes or until crisp.
Meanwhile, to make dipping sauce, place mayonnaise in a small serving bowl and marble through sweet chilli sauce.

Sprinkle sushi rolls, halved or whole, as well as the dipping sauce, with furikake, if using. Serve rolls with dipping sauce alongside. Watch our step-by-step video below to see how to make our crispy air fryer sushi rice paper rolls.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Garlic Butter Chicken Noodles recipe
recipes.description:
Juicy, golden chicken caramelised in garlic butter and fish sauce, then served over soft rice noodles with fresh herbs and a bright nuoc cham dressing – this is a simple, flavour-packed dish that’s perfect for a quick weeknight dinner!
What you’ll love about these Vietnamese garlic butter chicken noodles
This deceptively simple Vietnamese noodle dish with juicy chicken is so easy to make (just watch the video, if you’re not convinced!). It’s absolutely full of flavour and is set to become your new favourite speedy dinner – suitable for any night of the week and bound to push your go-to takeaway off its pedestal.
