Ginger: sharp, spicy and fragrant, ginger cuts through the richness of the sauce and lifts the whole dish with warmth and zing.
Pineapple: juicy pineapple pieces add bursts of sweetness and acidity, balancing the savoury sauce while keeping each bite light and fresh.
Green shallots: freshly sliced shallots bring a gentle onion flavour and a bright finish – the perfect garnish for both colour and freshness.
Rice wine vinegar: this delicate vinegar adds a subtle tang that balances the sweetness of the sauce and enhances all the savoury flavours in the wok.
Soy sauce: the backbone of the stir-fry, soy sauce provides saltiness, umami depth and that signature glossy coating.
Tomato sauce: a secret weapon for sticky fried rice. Tomato sauce adds sweetness and richness while helping to bind the sauce and give it a beautiful, shiny glaze.
ingredients: 227g can pineapple chunks in juice, drained, juice reserved
450g pkt microwave long grain white rice
instructions: Whisk together the tomato sauce, vinegar, soy sauce and cornflour in a jug. Whisk in the reserved pineapple juice (you should have about 1/3 cup).
Heat half the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. In 2 batches, cook the pork mince, breaking up the mince with a wooden spoon, for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl.
Meanwhile, heat the rice following packet directions.

Reduce the heat to medium. Add the remaining oil to the wok or pan. Stir-fry the zucchini, onion and red capsicum for 4-5 minutes or until slightly softened and a little colour. Add garlic and ginger, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until aromatic. Add the tomato sauce mixture and bring to a rapid simmer. Simmer for 1-2 minutes or until thickens slightly. Add the pork mince and pineapple pieces. Stir-fry for 1 minute or until well coated.
Add the rice to the sticky pork mince stir-fry in the wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or well combined and heated through. Sprinkle with sliced green shallots to serve.

recipes.title: Easy Fujian fried rice
recipes.description: You may know this classic Cantonese dish as hokkien fried rice, but – by any name – we think you’re bound to love this take on the family favourite fried rice.
ingredients: 10 canned baby corn spears, cut into 1.5cm slices
2 (about 270g) pork belly pieces, cut into 1cm strips crossways
instructions: Cook rice following the absorption method on the packet directions. Set aside to cool slightly. Spread onto a tray. Place in the fridge overnight to dry.
To marinate the pork, combine pork, garlic, sugar, Shaoxing and light soy sauce in a bowl. Season with pepper. Cover and place in the fridge for 30 minutes or overnight to marinate.
Place mushrooms in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water and set aside for 20 minutes to soften. Drain and squeeze excess moisture from the mushrooms. Coarsely chop.
Meanwhile, combine stock, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar and light soy sauce in a large jug.

Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add rice and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes or until heated through. Push the rice to one side and add eggs to the other side. Cook the egg, breaking it up into pieces as it cooks, for 1-2 minutes or until set. Toss the rice and egg together to combine. Transfer to a serving bowl. Cover to keep warm.

Heat 1 tbsp remaining vegetable oil in the wok over medium-high. Add pork and cook, tossing, for 4 minutes or until golden and crisp. Transfer to a heatproof bowl. Add prawns and mushrooms to the wok and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes or until the prawn changes colour. Add garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until aromatic. Transfer to the bowl with the pork.

Heat remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil in the wok over medium heat. Add carrots and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until softened slightly. Add corn, shallot and peas and stir fry for 1-2 minutes until well combined. Transfer to the bowl with the prawns and pork.

Combine cornflour and water in a small bowl. Add stock mixture to the wok and bring to the boil over high heat. Add the cornflour mixture and stir until the sauce thickens. Season with white pepper. Return the vegetable and pork mixture to the wok and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes or until heated through. Spoon on top of the rice, to serve.

recipes.title: Honey-Lime Chicken And Avocado Salad Recipe by Tasty
recipes.description: A refreshing and satisfying salad with juicy honey-lime chicken, creamy avocado, crunchy veggies, and a tangy dressing, this makes a great lunch or light dinner on a warm day!
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all the ingredients for the chicken marinade.
Toss in the chicken thighs and marinate for at least one hour.
In a cast-iron skillet, cook chicken on high heat until there is a nice sear on the surface of the chicken, and the inside is no longer pink. Roughly four minutes each side. Set chicken aside.
Place chopped lettuce, tomatoes, red onion, and avocados in a large salad bowl.
Slice cooked chicken thighs and add to the salad bowl.
In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients for the dressing. Mix well.
Toss the salad with the dressing and serve immediately.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken & Veggie Stir-Fry Recipe by Tasty
recipes.description: When you need dinner on the table fast, takeout is often the easiest option. But with our chicken and veggie stir-fry recipe, you can recreate a flavorful dish in the comfort of your own kitchen that's just as fast as takeout. Succulent white meat is perfectly seared to a golden brown, then mixed with mushrooms and broccoli florets in a savory sauce of soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, and sesame oil. Served over hot steamed rice or noodles, this is a complete and satisfying meal. The best part? You can customize this recipe based on what's in your fridge, whether swapping the chicken for tofu or shrimp or choosing your favorite mix of veggies.
ingredients: ⅓ cup reduced sodium soy sauce
instructions: In a large pan on medium-high heat, add 1 tablespoon of oil. Once the oil is hot, add chicken, season with salt and pepper, and sauté until cooked through and browned. Remove cooked chicken from pan and set aside.

In the same pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil and add mushrooms. When the mushrooms start to soften, add broccoli florets and stir-fry until the broccoli is tender. Remove cooked mushrooms and broccoli from the pan and set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan and sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add the remaining sauce ingredients and stir until smooth.
Return the chicken and vegetables to the saucy pan, stir until heated through.
Serve with hot rice or noodles.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: BBQ Popcorn Chicken Recipe by Tasty
recipes.description: This finger-lickin' good snack is a party in your mouth. Tender and juicy chicken bites are coated in BBQ sauce potato chips, then coated in crushed BBQ potato chips. Perfect for a quick and easy appetizer or a satisfying snack on the go.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and spray a baking sheet with nonstick oil.
Cut chicken breasts into bite-size pieces and place in a bowl.
Add the barbecue sauce to bowl with chicken and stir.
In a large ziplock bag, crush the barbecue chips into desired crumbs (to replace bread crumbs).
Coat each piece of chicken in chip crumbs until fully covered and place on prepared baking tray.
Bake chicken until golden brown, about 12 minutes.
Serve with a side of ranch dressing or any sauce!
Enjoy!
